slides.title: of Tigray civil servants back at work, officials say

slides.text: Borkena reports Tigray's interim administration says **salary payments** were delayed by **incomplete payroll paperwork**.
Chief executive **Dr. Teodros Aregay** says checks are done and staff with **cleared paperwork** will be paid. Not independently verified.
He also says the federal energy authority approved **fuel transport into Tigray**, with tankers reportedly loaded in **Djibouti**.
**Protect civilians, choose dialogue.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
